incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> prod:runtime.high_latency (triggered by p95 request latency > 800ms) :rotating_light:

Alex: acked the page :white_check_mark:
Alex: looking into it now, grabbing logs. Any customer reports?
Maria: Not seeing customer tickets yet, but a couple retries in monitoring dashboard.
Devon: I see a short spike across us-west-2 serving pool. KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x for ~40s.
Samir: grabbing the node pool metrics... also seeing a small surge in queue depth on gpu-1.
Alex: copying logs snippet:
``` 
2026-07-12T14:31:02Z ERROR serve: request_latency_ms=920 route=/generate model=redwood-3b shard=gpustack-1
2026-07-12T14:31:15Z WARN cache: prefix_miss=true key_hash=0x7fa2
``` 
Maria: could be transient (cache warmup) — any recent deploys?

Alex: trying a quick mitigation: disable continuous batching on gpustack-1 for traffic from route /generate for next 5m to see if queueing drops.
Ops Rotation: @Alex please coordinate with the rotation for handoff if this persists beyond 15.
Alex: applied temporary routing override (command: `redwoodctl route set --pool gpustack-1 --batching off --ttl 300`)
incident-bot: Routing override applied to gpustack-1 by Alex.
pagerduty-bot: Page auto-resolved (PD-90321) after alert condition cleared (p95 <= 800ms).
Alex: saw metrics fall back after override, p95 dropped to ~210ms within 40s.
Maria: nice. still want to watch for flapping; this looks like a transient cache churn + autoscaler join window.
Devon: adding a temporary alert suppression for gpustack join events to avoid noisy pages while we root-cause.
Samir: FYI I pulled kernel logs from gpustack-1; no OOMs, just connection churn on 14:30:10-14:31:30.
Alex: good candidate explanation. I'll follow up with a short postmortem note and a follow-up task to adjust cache prewarming on autoscaler scale-up.
Ops Rotation: handing off to Maria for next 30m — ping if it reappears.
Maria: acked handoff. I'll monitor dashboard and disable suppression in 45m.
Devon: adding a quick runbook entry: if p95 spike coincides with autoscaler activity + cache miss rate > 2x, consider routing override then check join logs.
Samir: noted. tagging PD ticket for tracking but closing the page since it auto-resolved.
Alex: thanks team. if we see repeated flapping, escalate to P1 and open an incident (customers impacted). For now I'll open a short task: `INF-4723` to tune prewarm and batching heuristics. :spiral_note_pad:
Maria: thanks — will watch. :eyes:
